title: lilium punctulatum
intro: Lilium punctulatum, commonly known as the spotted lily, is a species of lily that is native to the mountainous regions of Asia. It is a perennial plant known for its striking white flowers with purple spots. The spotted lily has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, treating fever, and relieving respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant effects. The bioactive constituents of Lilium punctulatum include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
